extract_cpp_docstrings: run mkdoc.py on C++ header files to extract Doxygen comments into Python binding docstrings
process_doxygen_comment: process a raw C++ Doxygen comment string and convert it to Markdown with proper formatting
sanitize_cpp_name: sanitize a C++ symbol name by replacing operators and special characters for use as a Python docstring variable
generate_doc_header: generate the C preprocessor macros and header boilerplate for the DOC() macro used in pybind11 bindings
extract_from_translation_unit: recursively extract documentation from a Clang translation unit cursor for classes, functions, enums, and methods
